A Nice but Weird Experience With Diphenidine
I had an experience with diphenidine today. I ordered 5 grams and when I got it I was ready for a good trip. I have never tried ketamine but know that this should be a close experience to that. I have read of other people that have used ketamine and diphenidine but, as a chemist all I know is how to make it.
I don't have a lab anymore so I had to order it from a supplier that I trust. All I know is it is very pure and I have plenty to go crazy with. I will also use it for pain control later since I am a disabled Marine that needs pain control daily.
I started with 5 mg to make sure I am not allergic to it. I have no reaction to it at all. So I then take 50 mg and IM it with one ml of DI water (deionized) which is sterile.
At 10 minutes I feel a buzz that ressembles prickly air. That's the best I can do for how I feel.
At 30 minutes I take 50mg more with 1 ml or DI water. I know that does not sound safe but that's what I did.
I am at 1 hour and I see the tv is 3-D and it seems so cool I can't tell you how how much I am loving this drug. Wow there is certain parts of the screen that are coming out and almost touching me.
At hour 2, I inject 20mg more and lay back listening to Led Zeppelin and it is as if the music is streaming in from some other place especially for me. I have this prickly air feeling and a sound that I have never felt before. I am not scared but, I do feel that my heart is racing but, when I take the rate it is only 85 beats per minute. That is weird to me but, true. What is going on?
At hour 3, I am kind of peaking because this substance takes a long time to hit. I feel way out there and am getting a special euphoric feeling that is great.
Never taking ketamine before I guess this is like that but, I have no reference to compare it to. It has some color tracing like LSD but not that nice total tracing that LSD does. The TV 3-D thing is the most awesome I have ever seen. It is so crisp and nice I think it is special and about as spiritual as I have ever experienced. I know that sounds weird but, it just is totally freaky how one part of the TV is coming out and the rest is HD but not coming out like one part is.
At hour 4 I am still peaking and have not come down at all.
Hour 6 I am finally coming down.
The next day I still feel some of the effects until day two.
I like this drug and am using it in small doses for pain control.
